_: Directories whose licence Chromium's metadata can't state, at this pin, among what the SDK links or ships (specs/0004-licences.md, Notices). Each names its licence and the file whose text the notices carry instead. Packaging fails on any gap not listed here, and a copyleft licence here would also need its source published, which nothing listed needs.

third_party/crashpad/crashpad/third_part.why: Crashpad's pointer to Chromium's own copy of linux-syscall-support, whose licence file it names by a path that isn't in this checkout.
Crashpad's pointer to Chromium's own copy of zlib, with no licence file of its own.

third_party/perfetto/protos/third_party/.why: Perfetto's protocol definitions of Android's trace formats, part of Perfetto, under its licence.
Perfetto's protocol definitions of Chromium's trace formats, part of Perfetto, under its licence.

third_party/rust.why: The directory of Chromium's Rust crates, which holds no code of its own: each crate has its own metadata and credit.

third_party/rust-toolchain/lib/third_par.why: Crubit's support library, which comes with Chromium's Rust toolchain, with no README.chromium.

third_party/swiftshader/third_party/marl.why: SwiftShader's copy of Marl, with no README.chromium.
